bio: This charming sister restaurant of KLE has moved to a new location. As before, the cuisine is plant-based and shaped by the Spanish and Moroccan heritage of chef-patron Zineb (Zizi) Hattab, who was born to Moroccan parents and grew up on the Costa Brava. Her modern take on the culinary styles of Spain and Morocco results in dishes that are brimming with personality. The plates are also ideal for sharing, making this the perfect place to spend a cosy evening with friends. Feel free to enjoy a drink before or after your meal; you can also drop in for a coffee or aperitif during the day. Brunch is served on Sat and Sun....
